text_en: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the states of Perlis • Kedah (Langkawi, Kubang Pasu, Padang Terap, Sik and Baling) • Penang (Timor Laut and Barat Daya) • Perak (Larut Matang, Kerian, Selama, Manjung, Bagan Datuk, Perak Tengah, Hilir Perak and Hulu Perak) • Kelantan (Kuala Krai and Jeli) • Terengganu • Pahang (Rompin and Jerantut) • Selangor (Sabak Bernam, Hulu Selangor, Gombak, Kuala Selangor, Klang, Petaling and Hulu Langat) • W.P. Kuala Lumpur • Negeri Sembilan • Melaka • Johor (Kulai and Johor Bahru) • Sarawak: Sri Aman (Lubok Antu) • Sabah: Tawau (Tawau, Semporna, Kunak and Lahad Datu), Sandakan (Kinabatangan, Sandakan, Telupid, Labuk & Sugut and Paitan), West Coast (Kota Belud and Ranau), Kudat (Kota Marudu) until 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10 October 2026.
